content.comment_body: My [product_name] is new, with [article_no] and an [product_name] module. I am only using one output. The example from [document] is the only program loaded. Ax is a Pt100 4-20mA sensor on AI1, and Ay is a fixed signal set by the [product_name]. When I set an on threshold at 10 and off threshold at 5, the comparator functions, but the output flips multiple times as Ax-Ay passes from 1 to -1 and vice versa. The same issue happens for thresholds set to 2 and -2.
Can you upload your program as a zip file? What is the range covered by the 4-20 mA signal? Is it 0-100 °C or something different?

Hi [user_name], I have used [product_name] modules on various projects and have not encountered the behavior you describe. I performed a quick real-life test setup, and the output behaved as expected. You may have a configuration error in the software; to check this, please send your program in a zip file. Also, if you are only seeing this issue in the actual installation, electrical noise might be causing it. Make sure your grounding is correct and the DC power supply is properly connected.
[user_name], I will check the grounding for my power supply and have uploaded my program as a zip file.
[user_name], I have uploaded my program as a zip file.

Hi [user_name], From your description, you mentioned "PT100." In the setup, "no sensor" is selected. When I configure my test setup with PT100, I do not observe the issue. You may want to look in the forum for tips on PT100 sensors.

analysis.insight_summary: The user reports output signal instability on their newly installed [product_name] system, where the output toggles rapidly as the measured differential crosses zero, regardless of threshold values. Community members point to possible causes such as electrical noise, software configuration errors, and sensor settings, but a clear solution is not established in the thread. Suggestions include checking grounding, examining sensor configuration, and sharing further details for improved troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants the output to switch cleanly and remain stable at the set threshold values, avoiding repeated toggling when the input crosses the defined point.
